fact: Marketing department led by Chris Moe (Director of Marketing, Experience), with 16 staff across four teams

Four teams: Journals & Data (Larry Grodsky, Assistant Director), Content/Brand/Design (Denise Herdemann, Assistant Director), Membership & Meetings (Lauren Hernandez, Assistant Director), Web Marketing (Tanika Williams, Web Manager)
Journals & Data team: Shruthi Parvathe (Data Analyst), Emily Richardson (Digital Marketing Manager), Bob Sumner (Marketing Manager, Publishing)
Content/Brand/Design team: Courtney Howert (Multimedia Designer), Meghan White (Senior Graphic Designer)
Membership & Meetings team (largest): Emma Ferraiuolo, Makenzie Furber, Starr Phillips, LaShelle Ralph (Marketing Specialists)
Web Marketing team: Dave Ellis (Web Producer), David Ralph (Web Producer), Merrill Miller (Web Content Editor)
Department mission: "The marketing team drives revenue and promotes physics communities through creativity, innovation, and data analysis"
Four key responsibility areas: brand elevation, Physical Review Journals growth (submissions/citations/readership), APS meetings participation growth, membership growth
Strategic project: CDP (Customer Data Platform) to unify customer data across Prism, Nimble, Pardot, and Salesforce into unified customer profiles
Strategic project: Global Physics Summit year-round marketing support
